lead: Customer discovery is checking, before you build, that real people have the problem you think they have. A friend's yes costs them nothing, so it can't tell you whether strangers will pay.
summary: This video shows how to validate a business idea with AI: why the usual questions fail (The Mom Test), what building first cost the IMVU team, jobs to be done (the milkshake case), and an evidence ladder from cheapest to dearest. It ends with a live run of the free Riskiest Guess Finder on an example idea, using ten real reviews of a planner already on sale.
